name: DoWI 8430.01 Accelerated Mission Software Alignment Profile
authority_boundary: This file defines a repository-local engineering alignment profile only. It does not assert government approval, certification, accreditation, endorsement, contract status, or authorization.

controls.title: Mission scope grounding
controls.requirement: Changes must be grounded in repository scope, provenance, and intended mission outcome.

controls.title: Reuse before rebuild
controls.requirement: Existing internal, open-source, COTS, SaaS, and prior ecosystem capabilities must be considered before introducing new implementation.

controls.title: Small testable implementation
controls.requirement: Changes should be delivered as small, auditable, testable increments.

controls.title: Parallel verification
controls.requirement: Testing, static analysis, dependency audit, secret scanning, and provenance validation must be part of verification.

controls.title: Evidence generation
controls.requirement: Execution should preserve test results, SBOM output, provenance, build logs, and rollback evidence.

controls.title: Human approval for consequential change
controls.requirement: Material external or production changes require explicit scope and human approval.

controls.title: Fail-closed boundaries
controls.requirement: Unknown authority, missing scope, missing provenance, and required test failures must fail closed.

controls.title: Bounded language
controls.requirement: Outputs may claim alignment checks and implementation mapping only, never government endorsement or authorization without separate verifiable authority.
